name: Summary columns
purpose: Lays out a few short facts side by side, in equal columns with a divider between them, so they can be taken in at a glance: a vehicle's year, fuel and colour, a driver's offences and points, or a vehicle's tax and MOT.

origin.notes: The app's VehicleSpecView lays out a vehicle's year, fuel and colour this way: equal columns, each padded 16pt, with the system's separator between them. It only lays them out: what goes in each column is a component of its own, such as a labelled icon. The counts and statuses the future driving designs put in columns are proposed components.

inputs.content: Two to four <govuk-app-summary-column> elements, left to right, each holding one component, such as a <govuk-app-labelled-icon>, a <govuk-app-count> or a <govuk-app-status>.

govuk-app-summary-column.description: One column, holding one component, such as a labelled icon, a count or a status.

rules: Use it for two to four facts of the same kind, worth taking in at a glance. For more, or for longer ones, use a grouped list.
Put the same kind of component in every column: all labelled icons, all counts, or all statuses.
Keep what's in each column short, so it fits in a narrow column.
Put it inside a card, such as a grouped list's content row with flush, with anything more about the facts, such as History, in a row below it.

references.description: A vehicle's year, fuel and colour, on its detail screen, in light mode

examples.name: Labelled icons, as a vehicle's year, fuel and colour
examples.html:
<govuk-app-summary-columns>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-labelled-icon icon="calendar_month" label="Year of manufacture: 2021">2021</govuk-app-labelled-icon>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-labelled-icon icon="local_gas_station" label="Fuel: Petrol">Petrol</govuk-app-labelled-icon>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-labelled-icon icon="palette" label="Colour: Yellow">Yellow</govuk-app-labelled-icon>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
</govuk-app-summary-columns>

examples.name: Counts (proposed), as a driver's offences and points
Statuses (proposed), as a vehicle's tax and MOT
examples.html:
<govuk-app-summary-columns>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-status label="Tax" caption="Valid"></govuk-app-status>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-status state="due" progress="0.75" label="MOT due" caption="23 days"></govuk-app-status>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
</govuk-app-summary-columns>
